title: StarNet
description: StarNet (Ma et al. 2024; S1 to S4, ImageNet-1k): a small convolutional classifier whose blocks multiply two branches element-wise. Apache-2.0.

Details
  • Paper: Rewrite the Stars, CVPR 2024, 2024-03-29
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models at 0df212b369a5
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/ma-xu/Rewrite-the-Stars (PyTorch): timm carries the architecture and the converted authors' checkpoints in its own, simpler API.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/timm/starnet_s1.in1k/blob/e3fbe6d1e24b6293fa6e7b897f380bd62f77e01f/README.md
  • Training data: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: starnet_s1.in1k (default of starnet_s1), starnet_s2.in1k (default of starnet_s2), starnet_s3.in1k (default of starnet_s3), starnet_s4.in1k (default of starnet_s4)
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: imagenet-1k
  • Input size: fixed 224x224: the input is resized (short side 256) and centre-cropped to it
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): starnet_s1.in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); starnet_s2.in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); starnet_s3.in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); starnet_s4.in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved)
  • starnet_s1.in1k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 6 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 24 s (ONNX + engine).
  • starnet_s2.in1k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 6 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 25 s (ONNX + engine).
  • starnet_s3.in1k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 6 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 28 s (ONNX + engine).
  • starnet_s4.in1k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 7 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 28 s (ONNX + engine).
  • starnet_s1.in1k original 224x224: torch.autocast(float16) around the call
  • starnet_s2.in1k original 224x224: torch.autocast(float16) around the call
  • starnet_s3.in1k original 224x224: torch.autocast(float16) around the call
  • starnet_s4.in1k original 224x224: torch.autocast(float16) around the call
  • starnet_s1.in1k load / first call: original 0.18 s / 0.26 s, portable 1.6 s / 0.241 s, kernels 2.2 s / 0.214 s
  • starnet_s2.in1k load / first call: original 0.17 s / 0.021 s, portable 1.62 s / 0.24 s, kernels 1.86 s / 0.06 s
  • starnet_s3.in1k load / first call: original 0.3 s / 0.01 s, portable 1.6 s / 0.239 s, kernels 1.82 s / 0.052 s
  • starnet_s4.in1k load / first call: original 0.21 s / 0.013 s, portable 1.66 s / 0.245 s, kernels 2.0 s / 0.051 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5
